author: EDJM9
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?
14
What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)
@edjm9#1086 
How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?
I can be on for 6-7 hours a week, and I can dedicate that time to building maps.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?
I think I am very good with building with detail and I am a fast learner. I also can know how to work with a team, and I think my opinion will help make Avicus Rotations even better.

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
To refine my abilities in gameplay, I believe I will need advice from other MapDevs on my current building abilities, listen to their feedback and correct any mistakes, and practice by building more maps.
How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?
Currently, I don't know much XML, but that is because I need someone to teach me. If I am given that opportunity, I would learn it so I can be helpful to other MapDevs and players. 
As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?
I would focus more on building, but as I said before, if given the chance I would learn XML.

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/0131147d7 <-- Agnitum (more for a scrim /5v5)
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/e3dd88a77  <-- Cinercius (my original idea, but Vice really helped refine it)
Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
Yes, as you can see from the maps above I am excellent at detail, and I am no stranger to Avicus Map Building. I have submitted 5 maps and 3 have been accepted so far. I plan to build even more.

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
I want to become builder because I feel that with this rank, I will continue to be motivated to create maps. Sometimes I slack off while building. But the Builder rank will set a standard for me in building maps, and serve as a reminder that I need to keep building in order to succeed on the Map Dev Team.
How do you think you will help the map development team?
I can contribute many ideas that can make the map development team grow and thrive. I also believe my maps will make Avicus even better than it is. I enjoy building maps, and I would like to continue.


Thanks for reading my application!
~EDJM9

Thanks!
- The Head MapDevs
